title: 📚 Optative Mood (विधिलिङ्)
description: Learn to express wishes, possibilities, and advice using the optative mood.

sections.title: 📖 What is the Optative Mood?
sections.content: The optative mood expresses wishes, possibilities, advice, and polite requests. In English, it uses 'should', 'would', 'may', or 'could'.

examples.अहम्: अहं विद्यालयं गच्छेयम्। (I should go to school.)
examples.त्वम्: त्वं पुस्तकं पठेः। (You should read the book.)
examples.सः: सः वनं गच्छेत्। (He should go to the forest.)

uses.example: त्वं सत्यं वदेः। (You should speak the truth.)
भवान् दीर्घायुः भवेत्। (May you live long.)

questions.question: How do you say 'I should go' in Sanskrit?
questions.explanation: 'गच्छेयम्' (gaccheyam) is the optative form of 'I should go'.

questions.question: How do you say 'He should read' in Sanskrit?
Translate: 'त्वं सत्यं वदेः।'
questions.explanation: 'त्वं सत्यं वदेः।' means 'You should speak the truth.'
